name: Wild Guardians
label: Quest
description: Wild Guardians: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In the northern areas of Winterspring, the Wildkin grow even more ferocious. We must continue our measures there.
Hunt the moontouched owlbeasts in Winterspring, and explore the area they inhabit.
This is dangerous ground, but I know that you will be able to handle the challenge. Return to me after you have slain 13 of the wildkin.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Don't tell me that you're too scared! Get going!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I sense that you are enjoying your work. And I believe that we are onto something here.
